styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Motown, the Detroit Institute of Arts and Eastern Market.

styles.label: History
styles.blurb: Motown, the Henry Ford and the story of the auto industry.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Science center, zoo and riverfront parks for kids.

stays.why: Walk to the riverfront, stadiums and the People Mover; easiest base without a car.
Next to the Detroit Institute of Arts and the Motown Museum; QLine streetcar to downtown.
Quiet, historic streets with bars and cafés; short ride to downtown and the riverfront.
Restaurants and nightlife on the doorstep; People Mover stop and walk to downtown sights.

food: Try a Detroit-style square pizza: thick, crispy edges and cheese to the rim. Many local spots serve it.
Coney Island hot dogs are a Detroit staple; several long-running diners downtown and nearby.
Eastern Market on a Saturday morning: produce, food stalls and a lively local crowd.
Greektown is the place for Greek restaurants and late dinners near downtown.
Middle Eastern food in Dearborn, a short drive west, is a local favourite; check hours before you go.
more_time: Add a day for Dearborn: the Henry Ford Museum and Greenfield Village show the auto and American history story.
Cross the river to Windsor, Canada for a different view of the skyline; bring your passport and check border rules.
Sports fans can swap a museum afternoon for a Tigers, Lions, Red Wings or Pistons game; check the schedule and prices on the day.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the art, Motown and history sights plus a good meal or two; add a night for Dearborn.

month_notes: Coldest month: highs near 1°C, lows around -6°C. Pack a warm coat, hat and gloves.
Still deep winter: highs near 2°C and lows around -7°C. Indoor sights are the plan.
Slowly warming: highs near 7°C, lows around -2°C. Still bring a winter layer.
Mild and showery: highs near 13°C with about 14 rain days, the wettest month. Carry an umbrella.
Pleasant spring: highs near 20°C, lows around 10°C. Good for walking and the riverfront.
Warm start to summer: highs near 26°C, lows around 16°C. Comfortable for most outdoor plans.
Hottest month: highs near 28°C, lows around 19°C. Plan outdoor time for mornings.
Warm and similar to July: highs near 27°C. Stay hydrated on long walks.
Comfortable early autumn: highs near 24°C, lows around 15°C. Great for parks and markets.
Crisp autumn: highs near 17°C, lows around 9°C. Bring a jacket for evenings.
Cool and damp: highs near 9°C, lows around 2°C. Layer up and expect some rain.
Cold again: highs near 4°C, lows around -2°C. Winter gear needed.

climate_guide.summary: Four clear seasons: cold, snowy winters, mild springs, warm humid summers and crisp autumns. Rain falls year-round.

items.title: Winter is cold (Dec–Feb)
items.text: Highs around 1–4°C and lows near -6°C. Snow is likely. Bring a heavy coat, hat and gloves.

items.title: Spring is mild and wet
items.text: Highs climb from 7°C in March to 20°C in May. April is the wettest month with about 14 rain days.

items.title: Summer is warm and humid
items.text: Highs around 26–28°C from June to August. Not extreme, but muggy at times; mornings are best outdoors.

items.title: Autumn is crisp
items.text: Highs fall from 24°C in September to 9°C in November. A light jacket helps in the evenings.

items.title: Rain any month
items.text: Expect roughly 9–14 rain days each month. Keep a compact umbrella handy.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers for spring and autumn, a warm winter coat for Dec–Feb, and light clothes for summer. Comfortable shoes for walking.

transit.best: Drive or use ride apps for most trips; the QLine and People Mover help downtown and Midtown.

modes.text: No metro rail. Don't plan around a subway.
The QLine streetcar runs along Woodward Ave from downtown to New Center; fare $1.50 for 3 hours. The People Mover loops downtown; fare $0.75 per ride.
SMART and DDOT buses cover the metro; fare $2. Useful but slow for cross-town trips.
Uber and Lyft are widely used; taxis also available. Handy for airport runs and late nights.
Driving is easiest; freeways are modern but rush hour can be slow. Check parking at your hotel.
Walking is good downtown; biking is growing with rental options.
